scripts.lint: pnpm run codegen:icons && pnpm exec eslint .
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm run codegen:icons && pnpm exec eslint . --fix && pnpm exec prettier --write .
scripts.typecheck:app: pnpm run codegen:manifest && pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.typecheck:node: pnpm run codegen:icons && pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:app && pnpm run typecheck:node
scripts.test:node: pnpm run codegen:icons && pnpm exec vitest --project node
scripts.test:ssr: pnpm run codegen:icons && pnpm exec vitest --project ssr
scripts.test:browser: pnpm run codegen:icons && node scripts/run-web-test-runner.mjs --config web-test-runner.config.mjs
scripts.test:storybook:meta: pnpm run codegen:manifest && pnpm exec vitest --project storybook-meta
scripts.test:storybook:smoke: pnpm run codegen:manifest && pnpm exec vitest --project storybook-smoke
scripts.test:storybook: pnpm run test:storybook:meta && pnpm run test:storybook:smoke
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run codegen:icons && pnpm run codegen:content && pnpm exec playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:dev: pnpm run codegen:icons && pnpm run codegen:content && pnpm exec playwright test --config playwright.dev.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:production: pnpm run codegen:icons && pnpm run codegen:content && pnpm exec playwright test
scripts.test: pnpm run test:node && pnpm run test:ssr && pnpm run test:browser && pnpm run test:storybook:meta
scripts.test:extended: pnpm run test:storybook:smoke && pnpm run test:e2e:production && pnpm run test:e2e:dev
scripts.storybook: pnpm run codegen:manifest && pnpm exec storybook dev
scripts.storybook:build: pnpm run codegen:manifest && pnpm exec storybook build
scripts.build:client: pnpm run codegen:icons && pnpm exec vite build --config vite.client.config.ts
scripts.build: pnpm run build:client && pnpm run build:images && tsx ./node_modules/@11ty/eleventy/cmd.cjs --config=eleventy.config.ts && tsx scripts/apply-lit-ssr.ts && tsx scripts/emit-navigation-artifacts.ts && tsx scripts/build-pagefind.ts
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.ci: pnpm run check && pnpm run test:extended
